📌 Tehran, IRNA – President Masoud Pezeshkian has commended Pakistan’s commitment to strengthening ties with Iran, stressing Tehran’s readiness to deepen bilateral cooperation across political, economic, trade, cultural and security fields.

President Pezeshkian made the remarks during a meeting with Pakistan’s Interior Minister Syed Mohsin Raza Naqvi in Tehran on Tuesday evening, highlighting the deep historical, cultural and people-to-people ties between the two neighboring countries.
​
The Iranian president said the commitment of Pakistan’s leadership to strengthening solidarity and expanding relations with Iran was highly valuable to Tehran.
​
